title: Navimower Map Card 0.3.2-beta2

Remove automatic mower artwork flicker during card startup.

### Fixed
- With **Mower icon: Automatic**, the card no longer briefly shows the H1/H2 artwork before an X3, X4 or i-series model is resolved.
- The mower stays hidden for the short unresolved interval, then appears once with the correct detected artwork.
- If Home Assistant already exposes a recognizable mower model in entity attributes, the correct artwork is shown immediately without waiting for the device-registry lookup.
- H1/H2 remains the fallback only after model resolution finishes without a recognized supported model.
- Manual mower-icon overrides still render immediately.

### Unchanged
- Mower position, heading, scale, history rendering and model artwork assets are unchanged.
- The card still ships as one `navimower-map-card.js` HACS runtime file.
